matrix_convention: 4x4 row-major, column-vector: p_parent=R*p_child+t; translations are mm. Apply parent_to_child_zero then local joint-axis rotation. Home-world matrix includes home rotations.
geometry: 28 rigid links with 293 named solid bodies in local frames. Imported B-rep geometry; no native SOLIDWORKS sketches/features/mates.
coordinate_convention: Link local +Z points distally, +X is palmar, +Y is thumb/index side. Shoulder anchor rotates pi around X in world, so neutral arm hangs down.
